title: LVMH’s Q3 2026 beauty growth led by Sephora, Parfums Christian Dior and Guerlain
summary: LVMH’s beauty retailer Sephora experienced strong growth during Q3 2026, with momentum across geographies and brands, including from exclusive launches such as Hailey Bieber’s Rhode, which entered its European stores

extraction.key_fact: 세포라와 주요 뷰티 브랜드들이 독점 론칭과 지역별 성장에 힘입어 분기 성장을 견인했다.
